digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — Bedrock native model instantiation and configuration
propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider; existing gateway-fronted approach loses prompt caching and structured output.

Prompt caching on Bedrock fails silently for some model IDs (e.g. opus-4-5) while billing full input tokens, requiring an observable warning when cache counters are zero despite non-zero input tokens.

Sampling parameters (temperature) are rejected with 400 ValidationException on some Bedrock model IDs (e.g. opus-4-7) but not others, breaking deterministic re-verification passes that send temperature=0.

BedrockConverseModel construction requires model-id-scoped capability overrides (supports_temperature) independent of profile-shaped overrides, necessitating a second override table keyed on exact model ID.
Runner.py at hard LOC cap (800) blocks integration of cache-zero warning and temperature omission; blocker task 2682 must land first to create headroom.

Live measurement confirms only inference profiles (not on-demand IDs) are invokable in the target account/region, and us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 profile caches reproducibly while opus variants do not.
